!- BEGIN general
hostname proxy-edge-01
console-timeout 15
banner login "Authorised access only. Activity is monitored."
!- END general
!- BEGIN ssh-console
ssh-console
inline sshd-keypair "end-12345"
...
end-12345
exit
!- END ssh-console
!- BEGIN https-console
https-console
port 8082
exit
!- END https-console
!- BEGIN snmp
snmp
community-string ro public
community-string rw Str0ngRW
trap-target 10.10.0.30
enable
exit
!- END snmp
!- BEGIN ntp
ntp
ntp-server 10.10.0.10
ntp-server 10.10.0.11
exit
!- END ntp
!- BEGIN event-log
event-log
syslog-host 10.10.0.20
syslog-host 10.10.0.21
exit
!- END event-log
!- BEGIN security
security
username admin
username auditor
exit
!- END security
!- BEGIN radius
security radius
primary-host 10.10.0.30
primary-secret "end-99999"
...
end-99999
exit
!- END radius
!- BEGIN ssl
ssl
ssl-versions tlsv1.2
ssl-versions tlsv1.3
verify-peer no
exit
!- END ssl
!- BEGIN forwarding
forwarding
create host upstream-proxy 10.40.0.5 http=8080
exit
!- END forwarding
